Changes.note: “Open the course” opens a draft course in the medrese’s name, in the köşk you choose, and makes the accounts you list its teachers; a lone teacher is its imam. The medrese’s “Closed course required” and “Enrolment always needs approval” policies are applied whatever the form says. Talebe do not see the course until it is published; its teachers and the medrese’s staff see it in the course list. The opening is written to the audit log. The course is not deleted: it can be hidden from the course list, and its teachers can be changed later.
